items.text: Before Pay or Scope, IT Before Pay or Scope, IT Before pay or scope, it is worth being precise about what BAMS actually is, since a lot of confusion in "is BAMS good" searches comes from unclear assumptions about the degree itself.

items.heading: A Single "Bams Salary
items.text: A single "BAMS salary in India" figure is close to meaningless, because government-role income, early private practice, and an established practice built over a decade look nothing alike.

items.heading: Bams (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine
items.text: BAMS (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery) is a 5.5-year full-time undergraduate medical degree, including a mandatory one-year rotating internship, recognised by the National Commission for Indian Systems of Medicine (NCISM).

items.heading: Bams Graduates Are Registered Medical
items.text: BAMS graduates are registered medical practitioners under Indian systems of medicine, legally entitled to practise Ayurveda, prescribe Ayurvedic formulations, and, with additional bridge courses in several states, certain allopathic medicines within defined limits.
